recipe.title: Khaman Dhokla

ingredients.name: natural citric acid
ingredients.prep_note: (or 2 tablespoon lemon juice or use yogurt, read notes)

ingredients.name: green chilies
ingredients.prep_note: (deseed and mince or paste, omit for kids)

ingredients.name: fine semolina
ingredients.prep_note: (fine suji/ rava, to omit cut down 3 tbsps water)

ingredients.name: Eno
ingredients.prep_note: (unflavored fruit salt or 1 teaspoon baking soda)

steps.text: Grease a 7 to 8 inch round or square cake pan or a steel container. Line a parchment if using an aluminum or non-stick coated pan.
steps.label: Prepare pan

steps.text: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together water, citric acid, sugar, salt, oil, ginger paste, chili paste and semolina, until the sugar dissolves.
steps.label: Mix wet ingredients

steps.text: Place a sieve and add the besan and turmeric. Sieve and mix well to a lump free smooth batter.
steps.label: Sieve besan
steps.doneness_cue: to a lump free smooth batter

steps.text: Whisk very well in one direction for 40 to 60 seconds. Cover and rest for 10 mins.
steps.label: Whisk and rest
steps.doneness_cue: Whisk very well in one direction for 40 to 60 seconds

steps.text: Pour 3 cups water to a steamer and place a high-legged trivet or a rack. Bring it to a boil.
steps.label: Prepare steamer

steps.text: When the water begins to boil, add eno and a tablespoon of water. Mix until well combined, thick and frothy, taking care not to overdo.
steps.label: Add Eno
steps.doneness_cue: until well combined, thick and frothy

steps.text: Transfer to the greased pan and steam on a medium to medium high heat for 18 mins, until a tester comes out clean. (8 inch pan – 18 mins, 7 inch pan – 20 mins)
steps.label: Steam dhokla
steps.attention_cue: steam on a medium to medium high heat for 18 mins
steps.doneness_cue: until a tester comes out clean

steps.text: Cool down completely on a wire rack.
steps.label: Cool completely

steps.text: Heat oil on a medium flame and add mustard seeds. When they begin to splutter, add curry leaves & green chilies.
steps.label: Start tempering

steps.text: When the leaves turn crisp, add sesame seeds and fry for a minute. Add hing, sugar, salt as needed and pour water.
steps.label: Finish tempering

steps.text: Bring to a rolling boil and mix until the sugar dissolves. Turn off and cool down to warm.
steps.label: Boil tempered water

steps.text: When the khaman dhokla cools down, invert it on a tray and slice it to 16 squares. (If you did not use a parchment, run a knife around the sides to loosen it from the pan)
steps.label: Invert and slice

steps.text: Spoon the floating spices on to the khaman and pour the water all over.
steps.label: Pour tempered water

steps.text: (optionally reserve ¼ cup to pour while serving)
steps.label: Reserve tempered water
steps.role_cue: optionally reserve ¼ cup to pour while serving

steps.text: Garnish with coconut and chopped coriander leaves, both optional.
steps.label: Garnish

steps.text: Serve khaman dhokla with coriander/ cilantro chutney and red chutney.
steps.label: Serve
